name: ch10_fig16_tpia_three_method_inputs
prompt: Title (top): "같은 tpiA 결손, 세 선택 기준" + smaller warm-grey "Three Assumptions for One Knockout". Start at the upper left with one shared baseline card containing the exact labels "textbook 모델" and "기본 배지". From this same baseline, draw two clearly separate branches. The upper reference branch goes first to "결손 전 WT 계산" and then to "WT 기준 flux". From the "WT 기준 flux" card draw exactly TWO separate, thin, direct arrows: one terminates at the header of Panel B "선형 MOMA" and the other terminates at the header of Panel C "선형 ROOM". Both arrowheads must be clearly visible. Draw no WT-reference arrow to Panel A "FBA". The lower mutant branch goes to one distinct card "tpiA 결손 mutant". From this mutant card draw exactly THREE separate, thick, direct arrows: one terminates at Panel A, one at Panel B, and one at Panel C, with all three arrowheads clearly visible. Never merge, cross, share a bus, or reuse any segment between a thin WT-reference arrow and a thick mutant arrow. Keep the WT reference upstream of the knockout and never depict it as a knockout output. Panel A marker "A" title "FBA" with criterion "biomass 최대화". Panel B marker "B" title "선형 MOMA" with criterion "WT와 차이 합 최소화". Panel C marker "C" title "선형 ROOM" with criterion "큰 변화 최소화". Each panel outputs one pill "biomass flux". Panel B and Panel C also output a separate pill "방법 목적값"; Panel A instead has a gray pill "별도 비교 없음". Add one red bracket across the three biomass outputs labeled "성장률은 biomass flux에서 비교". Make the temporal and causal order unambiguous: baseline first, WT reference computed before deletion, knockout mutant as a separate common branch, WT reference used only by MOMA and ROOM, and mutant used by all three methods. Do not rank methods or display numerical results. Exact labels only, no caption, paragraph, logo, watermark, or stray text.
